classes.name: VERIFIED_HISTORICAL_ASOF
acceptance: Exact original version bytes/hash and historical availability/publication or independent contemporaneous receipt evidence <= approved decision freeze
Historically attributable QC and revision chain/pins; qualified calendar/universe/security lifecycle and source/field semantics
Approved data rights/use scope and label entry/exit/maturity/provenance for supervised research; recoverable bytes
classes.potential_future_use: After Human approval, asof research under specified evidence class; never automatically trading/executable admission

classes.name: CONDITIONAL_RESEARCH_PROXY
acceptance: Traceable immutable raw bytes/units/market segment, qualified calendar/universe and permitted use
Human approves a separate fixed conservative-lag/proxy contract, revision limitations and missing/support rules BEFORE outcomes
Documented release/availability upper bounds or justified assumptions and predeclared sensitivity/exposure limits; lag cannot repair unknown historical revisions
Qualified labels/maturity, separated selection/forward/final and explicit non-PIT evidence class
classes.potential_future_use: New separately identified limited historical ranking proxy, only after new Human data/evaluation/compute authorization

classes.name: RETROSPECTIVE_ONLY
acceptance: Known endpoint/request/session identity and immutable bytes with actual current retrieval time
Current QC/integrity scoped and historical availability/vintage gaps explicitly retained
No inference of original historical publication or permission from public access
classes.potential_future_use: Source/schema/QC/restore diagnostics now; research-fit only after separate proxy qualification and approval

classes.name: UNKNOWN / REJECTED
acceptance: UNKNOWN if source/request/session/current-receipt/bytes identity cannot be established; absence of historical asof evidence with those retrospective identities established remains RETROSPECTIVE_ONLY. Rights UNKNOWN is a separate blocking use gate.
REJECTED for observed date/source/hash mismatch, invalid payload or failed required QC; preserve reasons, never zero-fill or silently use
classes.potential_future_use: Diagnostics/rejection ledger; not model input until resolved and separately approved

independent_axes.usage_permission_gate: Rights unconfirmed blocks research/collection independently; it does not erase a verified retrospective byte identity
independent_axes.research_execution_gate: Calendar/universe/labels/contract/compute admission separate; class alone never permits research
